title: 192 nabbed, P7.1M in ‘shabu’ seized in Soccsksargen ops in October

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Police authorities in Soccsksargen (Region 12) arrested a total of 192 drug suspects in October and seized suspected shabu worth P7.1 million. Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, Police Regional Office (PRO-12) regional director, said Monday they conducted 172 anti-drug operations last month in different parts of the region. Manibog said of the 172 operations, 86 were buy-bust operations, 45 involved the implementation of search warrants, 22 were through the implementation of warrants of arrest, 12 were police flagrante or response assistance operations, and seven were conducted through checkpoints.
